title: 加起来是几
subtitle: 加号、等号和好朋友数
character: wearing a yellow hoodie, grey trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration made of colourful plasticine clay shapes with soft rounded edges and visible fingerprints in the clay, flat simple composition on a plain cream background

pages.zh:
我在桌上摆积木。
左边放了一块，
右边又放了一块。
一共有几块呢？
我们一起来数。
pages.scene: The little boy sits at a table with two clay building blocks in front of him, one on his left and one on his right, looking at them with interest.

pages.zh:
左边一块，右边一块。
把它们放到一起，
一、二——
一共是两块。
一加一等于二。
pages.scene: Two red clay cubes side by side on a plain cream background, with a clay plus sign between them, a clay equals sign after them and two clay cubes together on the right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
中间这个小十字，
叫做「加号」。
它的意思是：
把两边的东西放到一起，
看看一共有多少。
pages.scene: One large clay plus sign in the middle of a plain cream background, made of two thick rounded clay bars crossing each other. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
还有一个符号，
是两条一样长的短线，
叫做等号。
它的意思是：
两边一样多。
pages.scene: One large clay equals sign in the middle of a plain cream background, made of two thick rounded clay bars of the same length lying one above the other. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
盘子里有两个苹果，
妈妈又放进来三个。
二加三，
数一数：一、二、三、四、五。
一共是五个苹果。
pages.scene: Two red clay apples and three more red clay apples on a plain cream background, with a clay plus sign between the groups and a clay equals sign followed by five clay apples in a row. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
五是一个好数字。
一加四是五，
二加三也是五。
它们都是五的好朋友。
pages.scene: Two rows on a plain cream background: the top row has one yellow clay ball, a clay plus sign and four yellow clay balls; the bottom row has two yellow clay balls, a clay plus sign and three yellow clay balls. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
十也有好朋友。
一和九，二和八，
三和七，四和六，
还有五和五。
它们合起来都是十。
pages.scene: Five short rows of clay balls on a plain cream background showing pairs that make ten: one ball with nine, two with eight, three with seven, four with six, and five with five, each pair separated by a small gap. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
手指头也能帮我们算。
先竖起三根手指，
再竖起两根，
数一数：
三加二等于五。
pages.scene: One clay hand with three fingers up and another clay hand with two fingers up on a plain cream background, with a clay plus sign between them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
如果拿走呢？
盘子里有五块饼干，
我吃掉了两块。
五减二，
还剩三块。
pages.scene: Five round clay biscuits on a plain cream background, two of them moved away to one side with a clay minus sign beside them, and three biscuits left together. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这个短短的一横，
叫做减号。
它的意思是：
从原来的里面拿走一些，
看看还剩多少。
pages.scene: One large clay minus sign in the middle of a plain cream background, a single thick rounded clay bar lying flat. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
算数就藏在生活里。
盘子里的饺子，
筐子里的橘子，
路上跑过的小汽车——
都可以数一数，加一加。
pages.scene: Three small clay groups on a plain cream background: a plate with dumplings, a basket with oranges and a row of little cars, each group neatly arranged. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把积木全都数了一遍，
加起来一共十块。
数对了！
下次我要数数楼梯，
看看一共有多少级。
pages.scene: The little boy sits at the table with ten colourful clay blocks lined up in front of him, counting them with one finger, smiling.
